scenarios.name: life-gain-replaced-with-nothing
scenarios.why: Any player who would gain life gains none instead: Revitalize leaves seat 0 at 20 but still draws the card.

scenarios.name: each-upkeep-deals-two-to-active-player
scenarios.why: At the beginning of each player's upkeep it deals 2 damage to that player: on seat 1's next turn, seat 1 goes to 18 and seat 0 is untouched.
